SymPy verifies the required two characteristic polynomials and algebraic identities from the embedded checker; numerical finite instances supplement but do not prove the quantifier.

value.rationale: Friendship graphs form a canonical connected non-tree family whose Connes distances are not determined by ordinary graph distances. The result completes every vertex-pair distance at all orders m>=2 and exposes a quantitative failure of additive patching across a cut vertex: interpetal/within-triangle ratio 3/2 rather than 2. The sharp cross-petal optimizer is a substantive five-dimensional spectral norm calculation not just another evaluation of a known one-triangle table.
